source.label: SoftBank Group Financial Report 2026, notes to consolidated financial statements, research and development costs (p. 51)
source.quote: Research and development costs included in “Cost of sales” and “Selling, general and administrative ... Research and development costs ¥ 507,590 ¥ 975,471 $ 6,101,270 [Millions of yen for fiscal years ended March 31, 2025 and 2026; thousands of U.S. dollars for FY ended March 31, 2026]

notes: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (SBG's 'fiscal 2025'). Taxes: net of refunds. The integrated report's consolidated net figure (¥784.3bn) matches the consolidated cash-flow statement's 'Income taxes paid' ¥821,620m less 'Income taxes refunded' ¥37,322m (Financial Report 2026); gross paid would be 821.62. By the report's breakdown, ¥699.5bn was paid in Japan (SBG and intermediate holding companies ¥463.4bn, operating companies mainly SoftBank and LY Corporation ¥236.1bn) and ¥84.8bn overseas. R&D: research and development costs included in cost of sales and SG&A, Group-wide; nearly double FY2024's ¥507,590m.
